introHtml: Hanes-branded waterproof dry bags combine the trusted comfort of Hanes apparel with durable, watertight protection for gear and clothing. These bags are ideal for safety managers equipping field crews with dry storage for electronics or for marketing directors distributing promotional kits at outdoor events. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a crisp, lasting impression that keeps your brand visible in wet conditions.
